tracking: Live engineering status board. Hyperedges are authoritative; predecessors are a checked projection.
ready_rule: A node is ready iff every predecessor projected from incoming blocking hyperedges is done. Root nodes are ready.

vocabulary.effect_surface: Non-authorizing risk metadata only: instrument.observe|instrument.configure|instrument.transmit|target.observe|target.transmit|target.present|target.mutate|target.destroy|environment.observe|environment.transmit|environment.actuate|instrument.administer|instrument.destroy. Execution authority comes only from signed, structured requested-effect grants.

nodes.title: Structured requested-effect templates and registry contract
nodes.intent: Represent provider effect templates and exact per-execution requested-effect descriptors instead of laundering authority through mutating/network_access booleans or broad capability families.
deliverables: Versioned requested_effect descriptor and template schemas
Versioned unit-aware physical-quantity bound registry using canonical units, min/max/rate/uncertainty, measurement-method refs, and reviewed provider extensions
Canonical spatial-envelope and stimulus-sequence refs for pose/distance/barrier and ordered interval/jitter/delay/cadence constraints
Non-authorizing effect_surface metadata in TOOL_MANIFEST and telemetry
nodes.engineering_gate: Unknown templates, subjects, channels, persistence modes, quantity IDs, units, or bounds fail closed; a capability can request only the exact effect descriptors and spatial/temporal envelopes permitted by its registered templates.

nodes.title: Physical resource requirements and broker-aware scheduler
nodes.intent: Extend TaskGraph cells with provider-neutral atomic resource bundles and schedule them through broker reservations so multi-instrument contention, media custody, observers, controls, operator presence, RF containment, power, thermal limits, mode changes, and workspace churn are explicit and deterministic.
deliverables: Atomic resource_bundle schema for one or more instrument aliases, target media custody, required capabilities/effects, observers, controls, operator presence, RF zone/band, attempt budgets, power, battery/thermal limits, cooldown, and exclusive/shared ownership
TaskGraph contract/hash projection for resource requirements and reservation state
All-or-nothing broker reservation with fencing tokens, TTL, rollback, and deadlock avoidance
Cancellation, preemption, stale-graph recheck, and cleanup handoff
Unschedulable-cell disposition with no coverage credit
nodes.engineering_gate: Candidate eligibility and deterministic selection consume contract-hashed resource bundles and reservation state. A cell cannot dispatch until every resource is reserved atomically; stale graph/hash state, fencing tokens, conflicting owners, missing media custody/observers/controls/operator presence, deadlock, expired TTL, power/thermal budget, and unsafe mode/workspace transitions fail closed, while compatible work is fairly batched without widening authority.

nodes.title: Scalable physical campaign partitioning and closure accumulator
nodes.intent: Preserve exhaustive applicable-cell closure when a physical campaign exceeds one TaskGraph event ledger by partitioning work deterministically without weakening one immutable authority, experiment, evidence, or completion contract.
deliverables: Deterministic shard key over the session nucleus, capability-pack digest, and declared coverage dimensions
Bounded per-shard TaskGraph/event ledgers with signed closure roots
Merkle-linked aggregate campaign manifest proving no missing or duplicate cells
Crash-safe resumable reconciliation and idempotent shard handoff
Retention-safe terminal witness compaction without treating trimmed logs as the authority source
Synthetic campaign fixture above the current 18,000-event ceiling
nodes.engineering_gate: A campaign whose deterministic expansion exceeds 18,000 TaskGraph events freezes, resumes, and reaches the same terminal cell set and aggregate closure root across crashes and traversal orders; missing, duplicate, unlinked, authority-drifted, or trimmed-without-checkpoint cells fail closure.

nodes.title: Asset-scoped engagement authority
nodes.intent: Authorize exact instruments, source assets, verifier assets, requested-effect descriptors, and graph transitions without physical-domain special cases, then project an unsigned normalized request for a privilege-separated policy issuer.
deliverables: Physical asset/effect axis in Bob's existing hash-bound session nucleus
Closed discriminated one-use grant kinds: bootstrap, preparation, active, and maintenance, plus the separately rooted nondelegable cleanup capability

Bootstrap grants bind enrollment candidate, bootstrap manifest/provider binary/transport digests, exact instrument-local read-only operation, authority epoch, nonce, and expiry but cannot require the inventory they produce; preparation grants bind the resulting inventory/assurance/provider manifest and may produce a workspace snapshot under RF-off/no-target-effect invariants; active grants additionally require task/pack/plan, exact effect/transition, resource/fence/lease, observer/control, and prior snapshot bindings; maintenance grants are operator-only and bind an owned fixture plus pre-state, terminal-state, assurance invalidation, recovery-or-quarantine, and HIL plans

Active one-use grant schema bound to node_id, contract_hash, prep_token_hash, dispatch_event_id, graph_context_hash, capability-pack identity/version/digest, technique_cell_id, caller role/requester/execution principals, experiment_plan_hash, session_nucleus_hash, execution_request_digest, instrument inventory/provenance and assurance-claims digest, provider-manifest digest, exact effects and authorized expected transitions, atomic resource-bundle digest/fencing token, lease and snapshot, observer/control/cleanup plans, authority epoch, revocation generation, signer key, and expiry
Nondelegable cleanup capability that survives scope/lifecycle failure
nodes.engineering_gate: The MCP cannot sign a grant. Grant-kind schemas are closed and mutually exclusive: bootstrap cannot carry target/environment effects or claim prior inventory/snapshot, preparation cannot carry target/environment effects and must consume bootstrap inventory, active cannot omit prior inventory/snapshot/plan/resource bindings, and maintenance is operator-only with owned-fixture terminal-state custody. The issuer proves the node is still dispatched where the kind requires task dispatch, its contract is current, and its role permits the exact request. Any required task, pack, principal, experiment, asset, nucleus, inventory/assurance, provider manifest, parameter, effect, transition, resource bundle, fencing token, lease, snapshot, signer-key, authority-epoch, revocation-generation, or execution-request-digest drift fails independently at issuance and execution.

nodes.title: Privilege-separated instrument broker
nodes.intent: Split policy issuance from device execution outside the agent security principal and accept only typed operations carrying a valid one-use execution grant over authenticated local IPC.
deliverables: Bounded authenticated IPC whose peer credentials bind exactly to ipc_peer_principal_id
Grant-signing policy issuer that imports and revalidates the operator-authorized immutable session nucleus but cannot open hardware
Device-owning active execution worker with a distinct receipt/provenance key and no grant-signing key
One-time plan/grant-bound vault ingest and materialization capabilities for the active worker, with exact artifact handles, byte ceilings, zeroization, and no model-visible bytes
Cleanup-only recovery worker that may open the enrolled device and materialize only the precommitted snapshot/restore digest authorized by the safety root
Normative principal-by-key/device/journal/ledger/vault/store ACL matrix covering provisioning, trust distribution, rotation, recovery, and anti-rollback
Mock-only same-UID test mode with no hardware provider loading
Epoch/generation synchronization, key rotation, nonce/sequence replay ledger, and fail-closed signature/scope/effect/task revalidation
nodes.engineering_gate: A same-UID runtime can load only the deterministic mock; hardware requires separated issuer and execution identities. The issuer cannot open the device, the worker cannot mint grants, and forged, replayed, revoked, over-broad, stale-epoch, or parameter-drifted grants are refused.
nodes.hil_gate: Negative-access tests prove the agent and issuer cannot open the hardware node; the agent and workers cannot read grant-signing material; the agent and issuer cannot read worker receipt keys; and forbidden principals cannot read, sign, write, or inherit descriptors through shell indirection, symlink/hardlink paths, backups, or crash artifacts. Only the active worker or a cleanup-only recovery worker constrained to the precommitted restore digest can open the enrolled device, and same-UID hardware mode is unavailable.

nodes.title: Versioned provider ABI
nodes.intent: Freeze the boundary between device transports and Bob semantics: inventory, capabilities, prepare, snapshot, execute, status, stop, reconcile, restore, and health.
deliverables: Closed normalized-operation schema and semantic registry
nodes.engineering_gate: A provider cannot accept or return undeclared operations/effects or raw secret bytes in the public result envelope. Every effectful attempt is journaled before dispatch, status-reconcilable after interruption, and never automatically retried from an ambiguous state.

nodes.title: Opaque sensitive-artifact vault and indirection
nodes.intent: Keep identifiers, traces, credential images, nonces, keys, payment data, and device state in a privilege-separated vault whose handles, transform inputs, and cryptographic keys are unavailable to model-facing resolution paths.
deliverables: Randomized AEAD storage plus vault-internal content digests and engagement-keyed secret-HMAC comparison tokens
Vault decrypt/HMAC/export keys unavailable to the agent principal
Allowlisted handle-in/handle-out transform worker with tool/version provenance and bounded summaries
Pre-stimulus capacity/quota reservation and disk-full backpressure
Retention, deletion, cryptographic erasure, safe garbage collection, backup, corruption detection, and recovery contracts
nodes.engineering_gate: Traversal, symlink, handle guessing, cross-session correlation, low-entropy offline guessing, unregistered transforms, dump/key leakage, plaintext-secret storage, exhausted quota, disk-full, corrupt backup/restore, unsafe garbage collection, and prompt-resolution tests fail closed before stimulus; MCP returns only masked summaries and random scoped handles, and deletion/crypto-erasure receipts are auditable.
nodes.hil_gate: From the model-facing OS principal, vault ciphertext may be present but decrypt/HMAC/export keys, plaintext, direct transform inputs, and the operator export channel are inaccessible; an allowlisted worker consumes handles and emits only handles, provenance, and bounded summaries.

nodes.title: Physical experiment and differential contract
nodes.intent: Bind an immutable physical experiment plan to append-only signed execution, observation, verifier, and cleanup rows while keeping claim and cleanup adjudication separate.
deliverables: Immutable physical_experiment_plan schema bound to session_nucleus_hash, task/attempt identity, execution_request_digest, hypothesis/predicate, expected positive/control outcomes, verifier template/version/digest, decision-rule digest, observation window, clock-uncertainty ceiling, and retry policy
Canonical plan hash over immutable fields only
Reusable signed-row envelope over signer key, scheme, trust-root epoch, and signature
Append-only attempt-bound execution-receipt, observation, verifier-verdict, and cleanup-verdict row contracts
Observation trust-domain and signer provenance contract
Derived rebuildable index with separate claim_verdict_ref and cleanup_verdict_ref
nodes.engineering_gate: A verdict cannot mutate the hashed plan; canonical signed rows rejoin deterministically. An instrument receipt and an observation from the same trust domain cannot alone prove an external outcome; a positive without a discriminating control remains inconclusive, and cleanup status cannot rewrite the claim result.

nodes.title: Instrument lease, cancellation, and restoration contract
nodes.intent: Serialize effectful work, bound active modes, durably journal execution before stimulus, stop active operations independently of a failed provider path, and precommit a nondelegable cleanup plan that remains callable after cancellation, failure, or scope expiry.
deliverables: Crash-durable command journal and outbox with fsync-before-effect ordering
Attempt state machine with prepared, dispatched, acknowledged, ambiguous_effect, restored, quarantined, irreversible_authorized, and unknown_effect terminals
Independent safety supervisor, deadman heartbeat, worker fencing/kill, and device/RF reset path where hardware permits
Precommitted cleanup operation set under a narrow non-agent-held safety root
Cleanup-only recovery-worker bootstrap constrained to the enrolled device, snapshot, lease, and exact restore digest
Separately preauthorized external-media rollback or quarantine plan
Startup status reconciliation and stale-lease recovery
nodes.engineering_gate: Concurrent owners are refused; timeout, cancellation, disconnect, issuer/worker death, and revocation push trigger bounded stop/fencing and the precommitted restore path. An unacknowledged effect is reconciled to status or quarantined and never automatically retried. Cleanup's narrow safety root survives active-authority invalidation but can never introduce instrument.administer or instrument.destroy; separate maintenance remains a new operation.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned-fixture worker-kill, disconnect, and restart tests prove the cleanup-only principal can materialize only the precommitted snapshot, restore or quarantine deterministically, and cannot read any other vault artifact or invoke administration/destruction.

nodes.title: Physical surface-graph ontology
nodes.intent: Represent generic physical entities, representations, interfaces, observers, controls, enclosures, zones, and state transitions in Bob's existing surface graph without encoding a hotel, credential technology, or provider model.
deliverables: Closed, versioned interface, medium, signal-source, actuator, control-point, verifier, enclosure, zone, node, and edge vocabularies

N-ary verifier-bound experiment/transition projection carrying nucleus, verdict, signer/trust-root epoch, upstream execution, physical-state epoch, validity, custody/capability-instance, and context bindings
Atomic locked persistence with crash recovery
nodes.engineering_gate: Only server-verifier-approved outcomes mint demonstrated edges; unknown node/edge/provenance values fail closed; writes are atomic and locked. Signed observations remain experiment inputs and inferred hypotheses remain TaskGraph proposals. Historical edges can remain facts after freshness/custody expiry but cannot satisfy a live capability prerequisite.

nodes.title: Physical-security capability-pack and lifecycle contract
nodes.intent: Make physical security a routed capability family with aggressive applicable-cell closure and existing SETUP-to-REPORT governance.
deliverables: Fail-closed physical surface class and physical_security pack
Pack-declared cell dimensions, finding schema, verdict kind, grade binding, replay strategy, and evidence renderer
nodes.engineering_gate: Unknown physical surfaces fail closed instead of falling through to web; success does not close coverage, and every applicable cell terminates verified, denied, inconclusive, blocked, or not_applicable before freeze.

nodes.title: Generic executed-evidence and verifier registry
nodes.intent: Extend Bob's existing evidence and composition substrate with open registries for executed-evidence sources and verifier templates so physical proof composes without a physical-only ledger or source-specific branch.
deliverables: Replay-executor adapter contract for re-execute and verified-verdict bind modes

Closed dependency-proof-provider registry whose compiler, conformance, observer, transport, and vault-tool entries bind owner principal, artifact/tool digest, signed verdict type, trust epoch, freshness, and revocation
Strict integrity, signer-trust, execution-identity, node-contract digest, context-digest, surface, outcome, and cleanup projections
Compatibility adapters for existing offensive and invariant run sources
nodes.engineering_gate: Unregistered, unresolved, stale, revoked, digest-drifted, or trust-degraded sources, dependency-proof providers, context resolvers, replay executors, and verifier templates cannot satisfy admission or mint verified outcomes. Existing web and smart-contract verification remains compatible; a physical source and bind executor register without editing the dispatcher and run without base_url or httpScanFn while downstream rows bind execution_identity, node_contract_digest, and context_digest.

nodes.title: Engagement physical-authority ingest and projection
nodes.intent: Import operator-authored physical assets, effects, transitions, exclusions, and optional constraints into Bob's existing hash-bound session nucleus rather than minting a parallel authority receipt.
deliverables: Governance-schema migration, compatibility, rollback, and unknown-version rejection
nodes.engineering_gate: Unknown fields/actions fail closed; raw authorization documents and sensitive asset metadata do not enter evaluator briefs.

nodes.title: Multi-source physical-observation ingest
nodes.intent: Ingest bounded observations from instruments, operators, controllers, and sensors with provenance and clock uncertainty.
deliverables: Attempt-bound observation schema carrying plan_hash, attempt_id, grant_id, execution_receipt_ref, execution identity, and a fresh retry challenge
Mandatory signed-row envelope carrying signer_key_id, signature/MAC scheme, trust-root epoch, payload digest, and signature
Operator-enrolled observer identity and trust-root registry
Plan/challenge-bound signature or MAC with monotonic sequence
nodes.engineering_gate: The evaluator cannot self-enroll an observer, assign its trust domain, or claim independence. Revoked, stale-sequence, untrusted-key, or wrong-plan/challenge observations fail closed; observations cannot contain raw regulated/credential data or independently mint findings.

nodes.title: Instrument execution and artifact ingest
nodes.intent: Normalize signed broker receipt references and opaque artifact handles through Bob's existing audit and frontier-event substrate without creating a duplicate instrument-run ledger or importing provider-private bytes.
deliverables: Signed broker-receipt reference schema bound to session nucleus, task, attempt, data class, integrity metadata, and signer trust epoch
nodes.engineering_gate: Tampered, stale, wrong-nucleus/task/attempt, wrong-data-class, revoked-signer, path-shaped, unregistered-provider/source, undeclared-effect, duplicate-execution, or unowned artifact references are rejected without creating a parallel source of truth.

nodes.title: Instrument capability index
nodes.intent: Intersect compiled semantic mappings, provider conformance, runtime device capabilities, and authority into a bounded availability view.
deliverables: Claim-specific identity-enrollment, firmware-provenance, command-surface-conformance, and transport-trust digests plus an explicit per-axis satisfaction relation for stronger, incomparable, not_required, and not_applicable claims
Digest-bound per-operation/per-technique variant evaluation over exact command predicates, provider conformance, compilers, vault tools, observers, transports, and manual procedures
Closed dependency-proof-provider resolution with owner, signed verdict type, artifact digest, trust epoch, freshness, and revocation checks
nodes.engineering_gate: Unknown device commands remain unavailable; firmware strings alone never enable a capability; no operation, technique, or parameter variant is advertised unless its exact command/dependency formula resolves; incomparable assurance vectors do not satisfy one another; and named compiler/conformance/observer/transport/vault dependencies remain unavailable until a fresh, non-revoked, digest-bound signed verdict resolves from the closed proof-provider registry.

nodes.title: Physical asset/surface projection
nodes.intent: Project authorized and discovered physical assets into bounded surface-graph slices without leaking sensitive identifiers.
nodes.engineering_gate: Same inputs produce the same graph hash; no raw UID, serial, card number, or precise sensitive location appears in the brief.

nodes.title: Technique applicability and coverage matrix
nodes.intent: Materialize dimensioned, pack-provided technique cells only when provider capabilities, target technology, scope, requested-effect templates, prerequisites, observer/control declarations, resource requirements, and trusted broker/verifier witness paths are present; actual schedulability is resolved later by PH-S11.
deliverables: Pack-provided physical technique and dimension declarations
Dimension-aware applicability resolver including pose/distance/barrier uncertainty and ordered stateful stimulus-sequence/cadence dimensions
Coverage-cell contract with trusted broker/verifier witness requirements, spatial envelope, sequence contract, and declared resource requirements
nodes.engineering_gate: Provider support alone cannot materialize or close a cell; every cell is pack-derived, dimension-complete, declares resources plus a positive/control contract, and reaches closure only from trusted broker and verifier witnesses rather than an automatic blocked disposition. This node does not assert that declared resources are currently schedulable.

nodes.title: Physical attempt and evidence index
nodes.intent: Materialize a bounded index over signed execution receipts, observations, controls, cleanup, and verifier verdicts without creating another independently authorable evidence ledger.
nodes.engineering_gate: Missing receipt, observation, control, or restore evidence is visible and cannot be inferred away.

nodes.title: Physical reachability and blast-radius projection
nodes.intent: Project verifier-approved outcomes into historical reachability facts and separately freshness-bound capability instances without converting reachability or prior possession into current authority.
deliverables: Verifier-bound N-ary transition nodes and grants_transition projections carrying session nucleus, verdict hash/ref, signer/trust-root epoch, verifier template/version, upstream execution/context, physical-state epoch, validity/freshness, and capability_instance_ref
Current custody/possession capability handle and read/dispatch-time revalidation
nodes.engineering_gate: A proposed or inferred edge cannot be upgraded to demonstrated without a verified experiment reference. A stale historical transition remains an attributed fact but cannot satisfy live dispatch unless freshness, physical-state epoch, custody, capability instance, nucleus, and signer/trust-root bindings revalidate.

nodes.title: Deterministic ABI mock provider and conformance kit
nodes.intent: Provide an executable provider-contract test double before the broker exists so authority, lifecycle, evidence, verification, and failure paths can be developed without opening real hardware.
nodes.engineering_gate: Standalone fixtures deterministically cover success, refusal, corruption, timeout, disconnect, stale state, and restore failure; the mock imports no broker implementation and opens no hardware.

nodes.title: Chameleon provider ADR, licensing, and dependency pin
nodes.intent: Choose a legal, Node-20-compatible provider substrate without coupling Bob core to GPL client code or native serial packaging.
nodes.engineering_gate: No GPL implementation enters Apache package surfaces; chosen dependencies pass Node 20 and platform install probes.

nodes.title: Transport-neutral Chameleon frame codec
nodes.intent: Implement or wrap validated framing, checksums, bounds, fragmentation, response correlation, timeouts, and cancellation independently of USB/BLE.
deliverables: Version-profiled fixed ceilings: 512-byte bootstrap/unknown DATA plus a source-hash-pinned v2.2.0 4096-byte DATA profile and parser ceiling, with smaller per-command maxima

No packet-size negotiation, runtime provisioning, or open-ended version ranges; every future outbound profile requires an exact reviewed version/source hash shipped in a code-reviewed provider release
nodes.engineering_gate: Fragmented, coalesced, corrupt, oversized, duplicated, late, and unknown-command frames are handled deterministically. Unknown/self-reported firmware cannot raise the 512-byte outbound bootstrap ceiling, the parser never exceeds 4096 bytes, and each command enforces its smaller declared maximum.

nodes.title: Chameleon USB CDC transport
nodes.intent: Connect through a broker-owned CDC ACM serial handle with injected transport, stable alias selection, and no raw path exposure.
deliverables: Operator-enrolled instrument alias resolution with ambiguous-match refusal
nodes.engineering_gate: Provider availability degrades cleanly; node paths and serial-derived identifiers never enter model output or telemetry.

nodes.title: Chameleon semantic operation manifest
nodes.intent: Map every supported upstream command to a normalized operation, effect templates, data class, prerequisites, technique bindings, and disposition.
deliverables: Pinned command semantic map from command ID and source symbol/handler/hooks to provider capability, normalized operations, worst-case effects, disposition, and source anchors
Digest-bound availability variants that map every supported normalized operation and technique to exact command all-of/alternative predicates and non-command proof dependencies
Closed dependency-proof-provider registry for compiler, conformance, observer, transport, and vault-tool predicates
Pinned manual-button semantic map with source symbol/hash, procedure, maximum effects, operator/witness receipts, and RF-off deadline
Admin/operator-only mappings with pre-state, terminal-state, assurance-invalidation, recovery-or-quarantine, owned-fixture, and HIL requirements
nodes.engineering_gate: Every command and manual action in the pinned upstream ceiling has one digest-bound semantic disposition, and every supported operation/technique variant has an exact availability formula. ID-to-owner swaps, formula gaps, unresolved proof providers, arbitrary normalized operations/techniques, unknown opcode compilers, or source/handler/effect drift fail validation; no vendor command ID leaks into generic capability contracts, and runtime-unknown commands remain disabled until reviewed and remapped.

nodes.title: Chameleon state, slot, and log stewardship
nodes.intent: Treat slots as broker workspaces, reserve Bob-owned capacity, snapshot existing state, and restore modes/config/log handling after every transaction.
deliverables: Vault-internal before/after digests with engagement-keyed comparison tokens
Preparation-grant path that consumes bootstrap inventory and creates the first RF-off workspace snapshot without requiring that snapshot as an input
Operator-maintenance pre-state/backup and expected-terminal-state contract with post-operation inventory, assurance invalidation, recovery or quarantine, and owned-fixture evidence
nodes.engineering_gate: Existing slot contents cannot enter prompts; crash recovery identifies and restores or quarantines drifted state.
nodes.hil_gate: After PH-P7 read-only inventory, a preparation grant creates (rather than presupposes) an RF-inhibited snapshot and a no-op restore produces matching engagement-keyed state tokens before any target-facing operation. Operator maintenance on an owned fixture proves post-operation inventory/assurance invalidation and recovery or quarantine without using the active cleanup path.

nodes.title: Chameleon BLE transport and security posture
nodes.intent: Reuse the transport-neutral codec over Nordic UART Service while keeping pairing secrets and bond administration outside evaluator tools.
deliverables: Staged USB/BLE parity ledger: safe transport/state parity here and every enabled target-effect family in PH-X5
nodes.engineering_gate: BLE secrets never reach the agent; unpaired/default-insecure posture is reported without exposing the key; transport switching preserves leases.
nodes.hil_gate: Operator-configured BLE and USB produce equivalent safe bootstrap/state results across MTU boundaries, fragmentation, corruption, duplication, disconnect/reconnect, lease fencing, transport switching, and snapshot/restore without energizing RF; target-effect parity remains a mandatory PH-X5 gate.

nodes.title: Chameleon first read-only hardware inventory and provenance observation
nodes.intent: Make the first real-device operation a minimal read-only bootstrap inventory against the attached Ultra without mistaking unsigned device self-report for cryptographic attestation or making device access part of CI, install, update, or release paths.
deliverables: Explicitly gated manual inventory under the closed bootstrap grant kind
Model and exact self-reported firmware provenance
Four-axis assurance classification and bootstrap exception
Redacted signed broker-receipt reference that becomes the input to a distinct preparation grant
nodes.engineering_gate: Only the PH-P8 bootstrap allowlist is callable; the grant does not require the inventory or snapshot it creates, carries no target/environment effect, and cannot be reused as preparation, active, maintenance, or cleanup authority. Ordinary test/install/update/release paths provably cannot open a real device, and unknown reported commands remain disabled.
nodes.hil_gate: The explicit manual gate records model, exact app/Git self-report, reported capabilities, assurance level, provider version, and redacted receipt reference while proving RF stayed off, device mode did not change, and no workspace was written. A broker signature authenticates the observation, not firmware truth.

nodes.title: Chameleon read-only bootstrap operation manifest
nodes.intent: Define the smallest transport-independent command allowlist needed to inventory an unknown attached Chameleon and classify provenance assurance before the full provider surface or any target-facing operation is enabled.
deliverables: Closed bootstrap-grant schema bound to enrollment candidate, provider binary/bootstrap manifest/transport digests, exact read-only operation, authority epoch, nonce, and expiry, with prior inventory/snapshot/experiment/resource fields forbidden
Read-only response and four-axis assurance schemas
nodes.engineering_gate: Fixture tests prove every bootstrap operation is instrument-local and read-only; raw passthrough, mode changes, slot access, RF activation, and commands outside the allowlist are impossible.

nodes.title: Operator-mediated manual-action execution adapter
nodes.intent: Turn source-pinned physical-button actions with no command ID into one-use, challenge-bound experiments without giving the agent physical access or treating an operator assertion as an instrument receipt.
deliverables: Plan/grant-bound operator and independently enrolled witness signed receipts
Before/after instrument mode and workspace observations
Attempt-bound manual execution receipt linked into the ordinary observation/verifier pipeline
No agent-facing generic manual-action or arbitrary-button surface
nodes.engineering_gate: A manual action cannot begin without an atomic reservation, exact procedure/source pin, active grant, fresh operator challenge, independent witness, and precommitted stop/cleanup path; missing, replayed, late, cross-attempt, or self-witnessed receipts remain inconclusive and cannot close a technique cell.
nodes.hil_gate: On owned shielded fixtures, field-generator and clone-button procedures produce challenge-bound operator/witness receipts, independently observed RF-off deadlines, correct before/after workspace state, and deterministic cleanup or quarantine without exposing captured bytes to the model.

nodes.title: RF discovery and credential classification
nodes.intent: Discover and normalize applicable HF/LF credential representations without confusing active reader RF with passive observation.
nodes.engineering_gate: Output is bounded/redacted, RF leases close, unsupported technologies become honest not_applicable/blocked cells.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned HF and LF fixture media classify consistently with independent labels.

nodes.title: Credential acquisition and authenticated read
nodes.intent: Acquire authorized credential representations, readable regions, auth coverage, and metadata into opaque artifacts.
deliverables: Explicit persistent counter/log/lockout worst-case effect variants
nodes.engineering_gate: No raw dump or secret is returned. Plain reads cannot silently invoke authenticated variants; counter, audit-log, retry-counter, lockout, and irreversible AUTHLIM-style worst cases require exact persistent or irreversible effects, attempt/state-delta bounds, and residual/terminal-state plans.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned fixture read matches an independently hashed expected representation.

nodes.title: Credential secret recovery
nodes.intent: Compose dictionaries, nonce acquisition, nested/static/encrypted/hardnested, and trace-derived recovery through vault-side handle transforms without exposing secret inputs or outputs to the agent.
nodes.engineering_gate: Techniques cannot silently escalate to destructive recovery; the agent cannot resolve keys/nonces or pass their bytes to host tools, and every vault-side transform is allowlisted, versioned, bounded, and emits only opaque refs plus safe summaries.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned vulnerable fixtures recover expected secrets with negative controls and deterministic provenance.

nodes.title: Credential emulation and controlled replay
nodes.intent: Stage authorized HF/LF representations in provider workspaces and present them under a bounded emulation lease.
nodes.engineering_gate: No unattended persistent emulation; every run binds source/verifier assets, effect scope, observer plan, and restore receipt.
nodes.hil_gate: Controlled verifier distinguishes positive emulation from a negative representation and records both decisions.

nodes.title: Credential mutation and external-media write
nodes.intent: Test mutable authorization fields and writable media with explicit target persistence, reversibility, pre-read, post-read, and rollback semantics.
nodes.engineering_gate: External writes require a distinct effect grant; unsupported or irreversible rollback posture is explicit before execution.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned writable media verifies the intended diff through an independently enrolled, assurance-qualified read path appropriate to the technology; a write-only instrument acknowledgement never counts as read-back. The fixture either restores or records an irreversible terminal state.

nodes.title: Technique-compiled protocol and scripted-responder experiments
nodes.intent: Compile closed, versioned technology/application/opcode technique schemas into bounded ISO14443-A/T=CL/APDU exchanges and static response profiles while keeping raw frames, arbitrary APDUs, and serial primitives broker-private; new schemas require reviewed registry extensions.
deliverables: Closed technique compiler keyed by technology, application/AID, opcode/INS, and bounded parameter domain
Per-technique opcode/AID/INS allowlists and worst-case effect derivation
Broker-private frame/APDU transport primitives with no arbitrary evaluator or operator passthrough
Reviewed registry-extension path for adding a new bounded technique schema
nodes.engineering_gate: Unknown/free-form frames, AIDs, INS/opcodes, parameter domains, response scripts, or semantic digests fail closed. Bounds, protocol state, data-class policy, worst-case effects, and teardown are schema-enforced; evaluator-facing raw passthrough remains unavailable.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned protocol fixtures replay typed exchanges and reject malformed/out-of-policy scripts.

nodes.title: RF interaction trace and signal analysis
nodes.intent: Normalize active HF reader-interaction tracing, emulator detection logs, and active-field LF waveform capture without claiming passive sniffing.
nodes.engineering_gate: Trace outputs are bounded opaque artifacts and every capture records whether the provider transmitted or emulated.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned reader/credential fixtures yield expected trace direction, timing, and decoded fields.

nodes.title: Physical differential verifier
nodes.intent: Mint verified physical outcomes only from signed positive/control executions, trust-domain-independent external decisions, and artifact integrity while adjudicating claim truth separately from cleanup state.
deliverables: Versioned physical verifier template and decision-rule digest registered through PH-S10
Verdict validity interval, physical-state epoch, trust-root epoch, custody/capability-instance binding, and signer provenance
nodes.engineering_gate: Tampered, same-trust-domain-only, mismatched-state, or uncontrolled experiments cannot prove a claim. Cleanup failure is recorded and blocks unsafe continuation, but it cannot negate or rewrite an otherwise proven claim.
nodes.hil_gate: A controlled verifier simulator and independent signed-observer fixture pass a positive/control differential without opening real hardware.

nodes.title: Physical attack-path composition
nodes.intent: Compose verifier-approved physical entity, control, zone, enclosure, interface, and reachability transitions into downstream physical or cyber surfaces without inheriting authority.
deliverables: Generic executed-evidence source, execution-context, and replay-executor adapter bindings
Physical verified-verdict bind path with no HTTP-only inputs
Causal binding of upstream verdict_ref, capability_instance_ref, current physical-state epoch/custody, and downstream execution_identity/context_digest
Proof of actual downstream consumption or fresh re-execution
nodes.engineering_gate: A physical leaf verifies without base_url or httpScanFn, while web leaves retain their HTTP adapter. Every downstream execution binds and revalidates the exact upstream verdict, capability instance, state epoch, custody, and consumed context, then proves actual consumption or fresh re-execution; every action independently rechecks authority, and adjacency never becomes authorization.
nodes.hil_gate: An owned fixture produces a real physical transition and a real downstream physical or cyber effect, with independent evidence for both. The consumption edge revalidates current physical-state epoch and custody, acquires fresh downstream authority, and composes only the causally bound edge. Simulated composition is engineering evidence only and cannot satisfy this production HIL gate.

nodes.title: Full physical coverage closure, grading, and reporting
nodes.intent: Close the full applicable pack-declared technique matrix, require zero active effects, grade only verified blast radius through pack-declared adapters, and render report-safe proof without physical-domain branches in core lifecycle code.
deliverables: Physical completion, zero-active-lease, and residue-accounting gates
nodes.engineering_gate: A fixture records, freezes, verifies, grades, finalizes, and renders a physical claim using only an opaque asset locator plus verified_verdict_ref—never endpoint/raw-PoC/exploit/SC shims. Every applicable pack-declared cell is terminal from trusted witnesses, all leases are closed, every residual state is verifier-bound and either restored or an operator-authorized irreversible terminal state, and no claim, grade, or impact bypasses its pack adapter.
nodes.hil_gate: The attached provider reaches a disposition for every reported command; the owned-media matrix closes with zero active leases, no secret leakage, and no unexplained residue. Authorized irreversible variants close only with a signed terminal-state verdict rather than a false restoration claim.

nodes.title: Generated role, tool, adapter, and permission coherence
nodes.intent: Keep physical role bundles, MCP tools, host permissions, prompts, and generated skills registry-driven.
deliverables: Server-owned verdict-adapter path for brutalist/final verification
nodes.engineering_gate: No model role receives provider admin/raw transport; generated surfaces and registry grants remain exact mirrors.

nodes.title: Physical redaction, telemetry, and context budgets
nodes.intent: Make physical identifiers, credential material, regulated data, raw device identity, and artifact paths safe across every output surface.
deliverables: Design-JSON sanitizer that permits package-safe typed schemes but rejects live HIL/vault/local-path overlays
nodes.engineering_gate: Seeded raw identifiers/dumps/keys/payment/paths cannot cross telemetry, error, brief, report, screenshot, or package boundaries.

nodes.title: Provider packaging, install, update, and doctor lifecycle
nodes.intent: Ship optional native hardware dependencies without breaking hosts that lack hardware, drivers, permissions, or provider packages.
deliverables: Explicit exclusion of the internal proposed-design graph and checker from published packages; live gate/HIL/vault evidence overlays remain only in user-owned session state
nodes.engineering_gate: Install/test/release never opens hardware; provider absence is a bounded unavailable state; native packaging passes supported platforms.

nodes.title: Provider ecosystem conformance
nodes.intent: Prove an orthogonal, non-RFID provider can implement Plane-PH end to end without changes to authority, evidence, pack, scheduling, verifier, graph, finding, packaging, or composition contracts.
deliverables: Orthogonal two-instrument GPIO-actuator plus optical-sensor fixture or equivalent SDR TX/RX fixture
Atomic multi-resource scheduling and external-verifier conformance
Pack, reachability, composition, claim/report, packaging, install, and doctor conformance
nodes.engineering_gate: An orthogonal second provider reserves multiple resources atomically and passes authorize/observe/act/restore/verify/reachability/compose/claim/report/package/install/doctor flows without physical-core code branches, RFID assumptions, or vendor identifiers.
nodes.hil_gate: An orthogonal second physical provider and independent sensor/observer fixture execute the complete multi-resource authorize/act/observe/restore/verify path with unit-aware bounds and no RFID- or vendor-specific core branch; mock-only conformance cannot satisfy this gate.

nodes.title: Hardware-in-loop failure and recovery matrix
nodes.intent: Exercise disconnects, partial frames, timeouts, RF lease expiry, slot drift, observer loss, recovery cancellation, vault quota/corruption, failed writes, ambiguous acknowledgement, BLE/USB parity, and restoration failures on owned fixtures.
deliverables: Recovery receipts and durable journal reconciliation
USB/BLE target-effect parity across every enabled effect family
Independent external-reader verification for write-only media such as T55xx

Owned-fixture maintenance matrix for BLE/settings/DFU/erase with pre-state/backup, exact delta, terminal state, post-operation inventory, assurance invalidation, recovery or quarantine, and no laundering through cleanup authority
nodes.engineering_gate: Every injected failure has one deterministic terminal state and cannot be misreported as verified success.
nodes.hil_gate: Owned fixtures complete the per-technique failure, USB/BLE effect-parity, and operator-maintenance matrices with no unexplained residual device or external-media state. DFU/settings/erase invalidate prior inventory/assurance and end in an independently evidenced expected terminal state, recovery, or quarantine; write-only media is verified by an independently enrolled, assurance-qualified reader rather than the instrument acknowledgement.

nodes.title: Active-instrument admission and revocation
nodes.intent: Build a provider-neutral active-grant admission gate that enables target-facing hardware only from a fresh assurance-classified inventory, task-bound signed requested-effect grant, exact availability variant, known provider mapping, safe workspace baseline, verifier plan, and generated role permission.
deliverables: Single-use active-instrument admission receipt distinct from bootstrap, preparation, maintenance, and cleanup authority

Binding to node_id, contract_hash, prep_token_hash, dispatch event, graph context, capability-pack identity/version/digest, technique cell and exact availability-variant digest, caller/requester/execution principals, experiment/attempt, session nucleus, authority epoch, revocation generation, issuer key, inventory/provenance observation ref and claim-specific assurance digest, provider-manifest digest, operation, parameters, worst-case requested effects and authorized expected transitions, atomic resource-bundle digest/fencing token, lease, prior snapshot, observer/control plan, execution_request_digest, and expiry
Closed per-operation minimum_assurance_profile_id enforced at issuance and execution using explicit per-axis satisfaction rules across identity, firmware, command-surface, and transport axes
Fresh signed resolution of every compiler/conformance/observer/transport/vault dependency provider
Revocation on formula, proof-provider, assurance, inventory, snapshot, task, pack, disconnect, lease, scope, key, epoch, or lifecycle drift
Fresh broker reservation and schedulability recheck
nodes.engineering_gate: The gate itself cannot open hardware or emit an effect; stale or mismatched inputs fail closed, receipts are nondelegable and single-use, and optional time constraints are enforced only when present in scope.
nodes.hil_gate: Admission against the inventoried provider succeeds without energizing RF; PH-X7 validates containment on a shielded non-target fixture, and PH-C1 remains the first node permitted to exercise a target-facing hardware operation.

nodes.title: Pre-effect containment and ambiguous-execution recovery
nodes.intent: Make active admission depend on a proven end-to-end safety supervisor, durable attempt journal, independent stop path, and explicit unknown-effect reconciliation rather than trusting provider cancellation or future-admission revocation.
deliverables: Bounded revocation push and signed worker acknowledgement
Independent deadman heartbeat, fencing/kill, and device/RF interlock where hardware permits
Operator containment procedure where independent electronic interlock is impossible
Status reconciliation with no automatic ambiguous-effect retry
Narrow cleanup-root, cleanup-only recovery-worker, and quarantine integration
nodes.engineering_gate: Across crash points before journal commit, before/after dispatch, before acknowledgement, during revocation, and during cleanup, the integration reaches one signed terminal state; an ambiguous effect is reconciled or quarantined and never retried automatically. Provider cancel failure cannot defeat the independent supervisor or operator containment path.
nodes.hil_gate: In an owned shielded non-target fixture, an external RF/power observer proves the independent deadman/interlock or explicit operator containment stops emission by the declared deadline across disconnect and worker-kill faults, without exercising an engagement asset.

nodes.title: Physical-plane schema migration and release readiness
nodes.intent: Converge the complete physical plane behind one release-blocking migration, compatibility, packaging, rollback, and evidence-sanitization gate.
deliverables: Versioned governance, TaskGraph/cell, contract-artifact, SurfaceGraph, capability-pack, composition, finding, and gate-evidence migrations
Reviewed node-contract and hyperedge-registry digests; resolved engineering/HIL/review evidence binds node ID, gate kind, exact node-contract digest, session nucleus, signer epoch, and verdict
Explicit physical-pack routing with unknown surfaces failing closed instead of falling back to web semantics
v1 read/resume compatibility and explicit v2 physical opt-in
Signed successor nuclei, grant reissue/revocation, idempotent rollback, and old-session fixtures
Clean install/update/uninstall/package/release audit with no live evidence refs or local secrets
nodes.engineering_gate: Old sessions remain readable/resumable under their original contracts, physical opt-in produces a signed successor nucleus rather than mutating an immutable hash, unknown schema/pack/surface versions fail closed, rollback is idempotent, packaged docs contain no live evidence, and the release verdict cannot pass unless every predecessor gate is verified.
nodes.hil_gate: A clean release candidate install/doctor run resolves every production-nonwaivable HIL gate to passed evidence, rejects waived or missing critical evidence, executes no hardware during packaging, and proves packaged artifacts contain no live gate, vault, credential, or local-session data.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Vendor-branded model surface
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Device commands and provider details are below the capability boundary.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Raw serial/CLI/APDU/TCP escape hatch
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Bypasses typed effects, scope, bounds, evidence, and restoration.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Same-UID sidecar claimed as isolation
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: The agent can bypass it by opening the device node directly.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Slots modeled as credential assets
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Slots are mutable provider workspaces; credentials have portable representations and provenance.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Sniff labeled passive by name
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Ultra HF tracing emulates and LF capture energizes a field; effect truth comes from provider behavior.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Instrument success treated as physical outcome
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Physical effects require independent observation and differential controls.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Environment-specific core schemas
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Hotels, campuses, rooms, doors, vendors, controllers, and schedules are engagement data, not framework ontology.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Secrets in prompts or normal reports
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Credential material and regulated data stay in opaque artifacts with separate operator export.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: Auto firmware/admin operations
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: DFU, reset, pairing secrets, and device erase remain operator-owned.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: First finding closes physical coverage
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Bob closes the authorized applicable matrix and measures blast radius before claim freeze.
